title: 完整人工智能培训课程资源库
summary: 该仓库包含由Fernando Amaral教授提供的完整AI培训材料，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法和模糊逻辑等。提供Python实践、项目和笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for Complete AI Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, GenAI, NLP, Agents, CV, anomaly detection, genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic. Includes theory and hands-on Python practice.
